metric: Highest token-overlap fraction between a gold outcome's cited evidence text and any single evidence item in the packet. Token overlap rather than substring because the gold set normalises source wording -- it writes F4/80-positive where the paper writes F4/80+ -- so exact matching reports everything as missing.
finding: The structured view, which ships as the default, has the WORST gold evidence coverage of the three: 12 outcomes below 0.5 against compact's 11 and full's 8. It keeps every structured item unconditionally inside the same 16k budget, so prose is crowded out. It buys GO-006 (0.54 -> 0.62) and GO-005 (0.43 -> 0.64) and loses GO-007 (0.77 -> 0.46), GO-013 (0.58 -> 0.42) and GO-015/016 (0.31 -> 0.25). Net recall is still better -- 11/15 against compact's 10/15, because GO-006 is reachable no other way -- but the default was chosen on that one gain without measuring the losses.
